TRIAL-001-EFFICACY.detail: expected=CAS change −1.2 (n=13) vs −1.5 (n=12), p=0.73; failure 69% vs 75%, p=0.75.

TRIAL-001-INTERPRETATION.detail: 6개월 CAS 변화와 failure rate에서 rituximab이 methylprednisolone 대비 우월하지 않았다.

TRIAL-002-INTERPRETATION.detail: n=2로 효능 해석이 불가능하며 dose 이해를 기다리며 종료되었다.

TRIAL-003-INTERPRETATION.detail: pediatric RAI/ATD 연구지만 posted outcome-measurement row가 없어 efficacy 또는 remission을 추론할 수 없다.

TRIAL-004-EFFICACY.detail: expected=Composite response 29/42 vs 9/45, p<0.001; OR 8.86 (95% CI 3.293–23.825); proptosis LS change −2.46 vs −0.15 mm.
Composite response 29/42 vs 9/45, p<0.001; OR 8.86 (95% CI 3.293–23.825); proptosis LS change −2.46 vs −0.15 mm.

TRIAL-004-INTERPRETATION.detail: active TED에서 teprotumumab은 Week 24 composite response와 proptosis를 유의하게 개선했다.

TRIAL-005-INTERPRETATION.detail: RAI 후 조기 levothyroxine은 8주 overt hypothyroidism primary endpoint를 유의하게 줄이지 못했다.

TRIAL-006-INTERPRETATION.detail: 선택된 rescue cohorts에서 rituximab/MTX 후 CAS 감소가 관찰됐지만 causal 비교는 불가하다.

TRIAL-007-EFFICACY.detail: expected=13 evaluable: TSH normalization 0%; total T3 below ULN 38.5%; FT4 below ULN 30.8%.
13 evaluable: TSH normalization 0%; total T3 below ULN 38.5%; FT4 below ULN 30.8%.

TRIAL-008-INTERPRETATION.detail: poor enrollment로 종료되어 feasibility 실패이며 efficacy 판단 근거가 아니다.

TRIAL-009-DURABILITY.detail: expected=Full paper에서 2명이 1년 off-ATD euthyroid였으나 uncontrolled spontaneous remission 대안이 큼.
Full paper에서 2명이 1년 off-ATD euthyroid였으나 uncontrolled spontaneous remission 대안이 큼.

TRIAL-009-EFFICACY.detail: expected=Week 22: TBII −0.6602 IU/L; TSAb −54 %SRR; FT3 −14.19%; FT4 −14.54%; TSH +0.309 mIU/L.
Week 22: TBII −0.6602 IU/L; TSAb −54 %SRR; FT3 −14.19%; FT4 −14.54%; TSH +0.309 mIU/L.

TRIAL-009-INTERPRETATION.detail: ATX-GD-59 Phase 1에서 thyroid/antibody biomarker 개선 신호가 있었지만 remission proof는 아니다.

TRIAL-010-INTERPRETATION.detail: PTU+alfacalcidol은 prespecified immune biomarkers를 개선하지 못했다.

TRIAL-011-EFFICACY.detail: expected=PRR 82.9% vs 9.5%, p<0.001; RD 73.45 points; overall response 78.0% vs 7.1%; CAS 0/1 58.5% vs 21.4%.
PRR 82.9% vs 9.5%, p<0.001; RD 73.45 points; overall response 78.0% vs 7.1%; CAS 0/1 58.5% vs 21.4%.

TRIAL-011-INTERPRETATION.detail: OPTIC에서 teprotumumab은 Week 24 proptosis response를 크게 높였다.

TRIAL-012-DURABILITY.detail: expected=Crossover responders 중 Week 48 PRR maintenance 29/32.
Crossover responders 중 Week 48 PRR maintenance 29/32.

TRIAL-012-INTERPRETATION.detail: OPTIC-X는 prior-placebo crossover와 selected retreatment/nonresponder cohorts에서 추가 response를 보였다.

TRIAL-013-INTERPRETATION.detail: RVT-1401 pilot은 strong IgG PD를 보였으나 clinical efficacy inference는 약하다.

TRIAL-014-INTERPRETATION.detail: ASCEND GO-2의 Week 13 clinical primary comparisons는 nonsignificant였지만 IgG/anti-TSHR PD는 dose-related였다.

TRIAL-015-EFFICACY.detail: expected=LS change −2.41 vs −0.92 mm; difference −1.48 (95% CI −2.28 to −0.69), p=0.0004.
LS change −2.41 vs −0.92 mm; difference −1.48 (95% CI −2.28 to −0.69), p=0.0004.

TRIAL-015-INTERPRETATION.detail: chronic/low-activity TED에서도 teprotumumab은 Week 24 proptosis를 유의하게 개선했다.

TRIAL-015-SAFETY.detail: expected=SAE 1/41 vs 1/20; hyperglycemia 6/41 vs 2/20; hearing impairment 9/41 vs 2/20; muscle spasms 17/41 vs 2/20.
SAE 1/41 vs 1/20; hyperglycemia 6/41 vs 2/20; hearing impairment 9/41 vs 2/20; muscle spasms 17/41 vs 2/20.

TRIAL-016-EFFICACY.detail: expected=Overall response 0/14 vs 0/14; CAS response 0/14 vs 3/14; PRR 0/14 vs 0/14.
Overall response 0/14 vs 0/14; CAS response 0/14 vs 3/14; PRR 0/14 vs 0/14.

TRIAL-016-INTERPRETATION.detail: secukinumab은 futility로 종료되었고 Week 16 response가 관찰되지 않았다.

TRIAL-017-DURABILITY.detail: expected=Week 52에서 initial responders의 70%가 PRR 유지; evaluable follow-up subset 21/30.
Week 52에서 initial responders의 70%가 PRR 유지; evaluable follow-up subset 21/30.

TRIAL-017-EFFICACY.detail: expected=PRR 70.0% vs 5.26%, p<0.0001; proptosis LS change −2.90 vs −0.48 mm; overall response 66.83% vs 5.26%; diplopia response 59.07% vs 19.89%.
PRR 70.0% vs 5.26%, p<0.0001; proptosis LS change −2.90 vs −0.48 mm; overall response 66.83% vs 5.26%; diplopia response 59.07% vs 19.89%.

TRIAL-017-INTERPRETATION.detail: THRIVE에서 veligrotug은 Week 15에 큰 proptosis/overall response 효과를 보였다.

TRIAL-017-SAFETY.detail: expected=SAE 7/75 vs 0/38; muscle spasms 34/75 vs 3/38; infusion reaction 13/75 vs 2/38; hearing-related symptoms present.
SAE 7/75 vs 0/38; muscle spasms 34/75 vs 3/38; infusion reaction 13/75 vs 2/38; hearing-related symptoms present.

TRIAL-018-INTERPRETATION.detail: linsitinib high dose는 Week 24 PRR와 overall response를 유의하게 개선했으나 low dose primary comparison은 유의하지 않았다.

TRIAL-018-SAFETY.detail: expected=SAE 2/29 high, 0/30 low, 1/31 placebo; high-dose GI/fatigue/transaminase signals.
SAE 2/29 high, 0/30 low, 1/31 placebo; high-dose GI/fatigue/transaminase signals.

TRIAL-019-DURABILITY.detail: expected=Off-ATD normalization은 해당 시점의 상태이며 durable remission 추적 아님.
Off-ATD normalization은 해당 시점의 상태이며 durable remission 추적 아님.

TRIAL-019-EFFICACY.detail: expected=Week 24 biochemical response without ATD increase 68.8% (95% CI 50.0–83.9); normalized FT3/FT4 with ATD ≤50% baseline 53.1%; off ATD with normalized FT3/FT4 31.3% (95% CI 16.1–50.0).
Week 24 biochemical response without ATD increase 68.8% (95% CI 50.0–83.9); normalized FT3/FT4 with ATD ≤50% baseline 53.1%; off ATD with normalized FT3/FT4 31.3% (95% CI 16.1–50.0).

TRIAL-019-INTERPRETATION.detail: batoclimab+background ATD에서 biochemical control 및 ATD reduction 신호가 있었지만 remission/cure 증거는 아니다.

TRIAL-020-EFFICACY.detail: expected=Active PRR 49.0% vs 31.2%, p=0.0715; RD 17.9 points (95.03% CI −1.6 to 37.3). Some secondary activity endpoints nominally positive.
Active PRR 49.0% vs 31.2%, p=0.0715; RD 17.9 points (95.03% CI −1.6 to 37.3). Some secondary activity endpoints nominally positive.

TRIAL-020-INTERPRETATION.detail: SatraGO-1 active-TED Week 24 primary PRR는 실패했다.

TRIAL-021-DURABILITY.detail: expected=Efficacy durability beyond Week 15 not posted.
Efficacy durability beyond Week 15 not posted.

TRIAL-021-EFFICACY.detail: expected=PRR 57.28% vs 8.22%, p<0.0001; RD 49.06 points (95% CI 37.71–60.40); proptosis LS change −2.35 vs −0.46 mm; diplopia response 55.57% vs 24.70%.
PRR 57.28% vs 8.22%, p<0.0001; RD 49.06 points (95% CI 37.71–60.40); proptosis LS change −2.35 vs −0.46 mm; diplopia response 55.57% vs 24.70%.

TRIAL-021-INTERPRETATION.detail: THRIVE-2에서 chronic TED Week 15 PRR가 크게 개선되었다.

TRIAL-021-SAFETY.detail: expected=Through Week 52: death 1/125 vs 0/63; SAE 10/125 vs 3/63; registry는 death cause/relatedness 미기재.
Through Week 52: death 1/125 vs 0/63; SAE 10/125 vs 3/63; registry는 death cause/relatedness 미기재.

TRIAL-022-EFFICACY.detail: expected=Active PRR 52.9% vs 23.4%, p=0.0011; RD 28.9 points (95.03% CI 11.5–46.2); adjusted proptosis difference −1.02 mm, p=0.0027.
Active PRR 52.9% vs 23.4%, p=0.0011; RD 28.9 points (95.03% CI 11.5–46.2); adjusted proptosis difference −1.02 mm, p=0.0027.

TRIAL-022-INTERPRETATION.detail: SatraGO-2는 active-TED Week 24 primary PRR를 충족했다.

TRIAL-022-SAFETY.detail: expected=SAE 2/64 vs 3/62; ALT 6/64 vs 1/62, AST 4/64 vs 1/62, neutrophils decreased 4/64 vs 1/62.
SAE 2/64 vs 3/62; ALT 6/64 vs 1/62, AST 4/64 vs 1/62, neutrophils decreased 4/64 vs 1/62.

TRIAL-023-INTERPRETATION.detail: feeder-trial nonresponders의 open-label treatment 결과이며 randomized comparative efficacy로 해석할 수 없다.

TRIAL-024-INTERPRETATION.detail: LASN01은 Week 37 CAS response 신호를 보였지만 PRR는 placebo와 유사했다.

TRIAL-025-INTERPRETATION.detail: STRIVE는 placebo 없는 active-dose safety comparison으로 efficacy 또는 dose response를 확립하지 못한다.

TRIAL-025-SAFETY.detail: expected=Week 52 TEAE 159/173 vs 55/58; SAE 10/173 vs 3/58; deaths 0; class-like muscle spasm/hearing/reproductive events.
Week 52 TEAE 159/173 vs 55/58; SAE 10/173 vs 3/58; deaths 0; class-like muscle spasm/hearing/reproductive events.
